createTaskArgs.title: SDK-to-terminal handoff - Phase 1: Managed resume tools
createTaskArgs.intent:
Make managed terminal resumes preserve Mission tools, permission posture and repository scope. Refuse unusable preparation before stopping a live SDK session, and retain the prepared environment for any terminal that may have launched.

Read docs/plans/sdk-terminal-evidence-handoff/plan.md, docs/plans/sdk-terminal-evidence-handoff/phased-plan.md and docs/plans/sdk-terminal-evidence-handoff/phase-1-managed-resume-tools.md first. Follow the phase file as the implementation guide. It is the proposed route, not a specification: use your judgement where the repository disagrees or a better implementation presents itself, and record deviations and reasons in the pull request. Only the goal is fixed.

Implement only Phase 1 in the current Mission Control repository, preserve its cross-phase contracts, and leave later phases and the separate Backlog UI feature alone.

Run the verification specified by the phase file and deliver a reviewable pull request whose merge can release dependent work, following the task's completion handoff and the workflow's later publication instruction.
